blocks.title: Recognizing phishing
blocks.text: Recognizing phishing means spotting fake messages that try to trick you into sharing passwords, card numbers or bank details, and not clicking their links or giving information.
An email that appears to be from your bank and asks you to click a link and enter account details should be treated as fake; contact the bank through its official number or app instead.

blocks.prompt: Describe two ways to recognize online threats and prevent cybersecurity risks (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Check every unexpected message asking for details: verify the sender and do not click its links, contacting the organization directly instead. Keep antivirus software updated and download software only from trusted sources, so malware is caught before it does harm.

items: Recognize phishing: suspicious requests for details; verify through official channels.
